Title: ServiceNow Change Request Filter Construction
Description: Step-by-step workflow to build an AND filter on the Change Request list page.
- Open the filter panel by clicking the 'Show / hide filter' button to reveal the filter inputs.
- Select the first field from the combobox labeled 'All of these conditions must be met. -- choose field --'.
- Choose a specific field (e.g., 'Type') from the dropdown and set its value using the option chooser or select_option action.
- Add subsequent conditions by clicking the 'Add AND Condition To Condition X: [Previous Field] is [Previous Value]' button.
- For the next condition, select the new field (e.g., 'Requested by') from the focused combobox.
- Enter the required value (e.g., 'System Administrator') into the visible textbox for the selected field.
- Repeat the add condition step for remaining fields like 'Model' and 'Short description'.
- For empty string conditions, select the field and choose the 'is empty string' operator from the operator combobox.

Title: ServiceNow Filter Panel UI Patterns
Description: Key UI signals and interaction patterns observed when building filters on the Change Request list.
- The filter panel is controlled by a button labeled 'Show / hide filter' with bid 'a47' that toggles the filter div.
- Field selection uses a combobox with the default label 'All of these conditions must be met. -- choose field --'.
- Value selection for fields may require clicking a combobox showing '-- None --' followed by selecting the option.
- If clicking an option in the value chooser fails, the agent should attempt using the select_option action on the combobox.
- Adding new AND conditions is triggered by a button labeled 'Add AND Condition To Condition X: [Field] is [Value]'.
- After adding a condition, a new combobox appears with the label 'All of these conditions must be met. -- choose field --' for the next field.
- Text inputs for values are standard textboxes that appear immediately after a field is selected.
- Operators for conditions are selected via a combobox labeled 'Operator For Condition X: [Field] is'.
